# Weizmann Institute of Science - Elsevier Pure

> Research repository and organizational directory for the Weizmann Institute of Science, featuring datasets, research centers, and facilities across life sciences, physical sciences, and climate research.

Weizmann Institute of Science's institutional repository on Elsevier Pure showcases research output across multiple disciplines including atmospheric science, molecular biology, materials science, and AI research. The platform aggregates datasets, research centers, and core facilities supporting interdisciplinary investigation.

## Key Topics

- Weizmann Institute of Science
- Research datasets
- Climate modeling
- Machine learning classification
- Meteorology
- GreenCu
- Cumulus clouds
- Genetic disorders
- Neurodegeneration
- Cell imaging
- Battery materials
- AI research
- Satellite data
- Plant biotechnology
- Particle physics

## Research Centers & Institutes

- [The Center for AI Core Research](https://weizmann.elsevierpure.com/en/organisations/the-center-for-ai-core-research): Center for AI Core research at Weizmann Institute's AI research organization
- [Melvyn A. Dobrin Center for Nutrition and Plant Research](https://weizmann.elsevierpure.com/en/organisations/melvyn-a-dobrin-center-for-nutrition-and-plant-research): Melvyn A. Dobrin Center for plant research and plant biotechnology at Weizmann
- [The David and Fela Shapell Family Center for Genetic Disorders Research](https://weizmann.elsevierpure.com/en/organisations/the-david-and-fela-shapell-family-center-for-genetic-disorders-re): Shapell Family Center for genetic disorders research and molecular biology
- [Center for Research on Neurodegeneration](https://weizmann.elsevierpure.com/en/organisations/center-for-research-on-neurodegeneration): Center for neurodegeneration research at Weizmann's Azrieli Institute

## Core Facilities & Research Infrastructure

- [Department of Physics Core Facilities](https://weizmann.elsevierpure.com/en/organisations/department-of-physics-core-facilities): Physics core facilities supporting particle physics and LHC research
- [Kleinman Cancer Cell Sorting Facility](https://weizmann.elsevierpure.com/en/organisations/kleinman-cancer-cell-sorting-facility): Kleinman Cancer Cell Sorting Facility for cancer research and cell sorting

## Climate & Atmospheric Science Datasets

- [Data from: The Large-scale Meteorology that Drives Continental, Shallow, Green Cumulus (GreenCu) through Supervised Classification](https://weizmann.elsevierpure.com/en/datasets/data-from-the-large-scale-meteorology-that-drives-continental-sha): GreenCu meteorology dataset with machine learning classification and satellite data
- [Data for: Tallest Clouds on Earth: Ground-Rooted Polar Stratospheric Clouds Link Storms to Ozone Chemistry](https://weizmann.elsevierpure.com/en/datasets/data-for-tallest-clouds-on-earth-ground-rooted-polar-stratospheri): Polar stratospheric clouds dataset linking storms to ozone chemistry research

## Cellular & Materials Science Datasets

- [Data for: Correlative cryo-FM and cryo-FIB-SEM of plunge-frozen mammalian cells: From sample preparation to image registration](https://weizmann.elsevierpure.com/en/datasets/data-for-correlative-cryo-fm-and-cryo-fib-sem-of-plunge-frozen-ma): Cryo-microscopy dataset with image registration protocols for cell imaging
- [Data for: Tracking Dendrites and Solid Electrolyte Interphase Formation with Dynamic Nuclear Polarization - NMR Spectroscopy](https://weizmann.elsevierpure.com/en/datasets/data-for-tracking-dendrites-and-solid-electrolyte-interphase-form): DNP-NMR spectroscopy dataset for lithium dendrites and battery materials
- [Data for: Sexually dimorphic architecture and function of a mechanosensory circuit in C. elegans](https://weizmann.elsevierpure.com/en/datasets/data-for-sexually-dimorphic-architecture-and-function-of-a-mechan): C. elegans mechanosensory circuit dataset studying sexual dimorphism
